title: Dallas Food Tour with 5 Local Food Tastings in Deep Ellum Area
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We strongly advise wearing comfortable walking shoes to all of our guests. Our tour runs a little over 3 hours.
*We can’t accommodate pets on our food tours*
Please ensure to contact us in advance of the tour for any dietary requirement, to ensure we can cater for them the best we can.
Please note: the itinerary and menu is subject to change, based on the locations' availability, weather, and other circumstances.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Y’all ready to taste the real soul of Dallas? Step into the artsy, mural-filled streets of Deep Ellum for a small-group food tour led by local insiders. You’ll savor 5 iconic tastings that showcase why Dallas is a BBQ and Tex-Mex powerhouse. Indulge in cowboy-style BBQ brisket, delicious traditional Adobada Taco, a spicy cup of chili con carne, cheesy chicken quesadillas, and a boozy pecan pie with a Southern kick. Finally, of course, as for any of our Secret Food Tour, enjoy our delicious Secret dish. 

Whether you’re a BBQ fanatic or new to Southern eats, this tour delivers delicious bites, cultural flair, and true Texas hospitality, no cowboy boots required!

Our guides will lead you through the art-filled streets of Deep Ellum. As always, there's our Secret Dish, which will only be revealed on the tour!
